segments.comment: Independent Asmodeus variation for the source-defined MS_BRIBE demon-prince family. The opening space clears the intro More prompt. C follows the same makemon.c:makemon placement and peaceful/invisible state branch; the existing makemon.c:m_initinv() arm adds Asmodeus's wand of cold and wand of fire. If the run continues into a later monster action, retain the recipe as blocked at that separate source owner rather than counting it as whole-session matching evidence.
